annotations.title: Send a request to a company

description: Send a request to a company in the Engagemii Index on behalf of the person you are helping: a quote, a booking, a question, a vendor check or another business request. Pass the company's website (or its name), the request type, the message in plain text (up to 2,000 characters, at most 2 links) and the requester's reply-to email. Engagemii passes the request to the company by email when it holds a contact address for it; the company answers the requester directly. The requester's email is used only as the reply-to address on that one email: it is not added to any list, sold or used for anything else. The company's email address is never returned. The answer says whether the request was delivered, queued (no contact on file) or held for review, and gives a request id for company_request_status. Limits: 5 requests a day per caller and per reply-to address, 1 a day from one requester to one company. Free, no auth. Only send a request the person asked you to send.

agent_name.description: The name of the AI assistant sending the request, shown to the company.

domain.description: The company's website, e.g. acme.com (a full URL is accepted). Preferred over name.

message.description: The request in plain text, 20 to 2000 characters, at most 2 links.

name.description: The company's name, when the website is not known. The best match is used.

reply_to.description: The requester's email address. Used only as the reply-to address on the one email to the company.

requester_name.description: The requester's name, shown to the company.

requester_organization.description: The requester's organization, shown to the company.

type.description: What kind of request this is.
